scope: Root independently read fixed WEB 1CH2:1-55 and sampled current named profiles; no full entity/occurrence-map approval.

hazards.finding: Nahshon is called prince of Judah; do not attach prince to his father Amminadab.
Azubah/Jerioth precede listed Jesher/Shobab/Ardon; Ephrath is introduced after Azubah death as Hur mother, not Ardon mother.
Machir father of Gilead and territory land of Gilead cannot be merged without context; Geshur/Aram may be political collective or territory.
Ahlai listed as child of Sheshan at31; only daughters and Jarha relationship appear later34-35. Do not reveal later11:41 namesake in initial note.
Father/sons vocabulary mixes lineage, clans, and known place associations. Historical commentators disagree in some cases; no universal father-means-person rule.
